summary: Resets camera-manager state for a restart: optionally logs an entry message when the StringSplitLoop gate on the startup string passes, re-initializes the camera state machine from the global constant block flt_5EA4E8, clears the stored player/entity id at this+0x38 to -1 and the byte flag at this+0x2E to 0, and returns the state-init result.

local_names.playerId: stored player/entity id at this+0x38, reset to -1
local_names.flagByte: byte flag at this+0x2E, reset to 0

operations.description: If StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_15, 3656) returns non-zero, the camera-manager restart debug message is logged.
StringSplitLoop gates the debug-log block on a startup source-string check.
DebugLogWrite writes the aEnteredCammanR string into the debug message buffer dword_8AD25C.
StateInitWithGlobalConstants re-initializes the camera state machine from the global constant block flt_5EA4E8; its return value becomes this function's result.
Resets the stored player/entity id at this+0x38 to -1 so the next tick detects a player change.
Clears the byte flag at this+0x2E to 0.
Returns the result produced by StateInitWithGlobalConstants.

unresolved: The exact semantics of byte flag this+0x2E and stored id this+0x38 are not evidenced beyond the restart-reset behavior.
StringSplitLoop's role as a debug gate and the meaning of the constants 2 and 3656 are not interpretable from this packet.
